As per the order dated 07.08.2024, the previous counsel appearing for the appellant Mr.Deviprasad Shetty was permitted to retire from the case, as he was unable to get the instructions from the appellant and he was also not able to contact the appellant.
This shows that the appellant is not interested in prosecuting this appeal.
Hence, the appeal is dismissed for non-prosecution.
